title: Valid Brackets
story: Does every bracket have a partner in the right order?
goal: Write valid(s): True if the brackets ()[]{} in s are balanced and properly nested, otherwise False.
hints: Push openers on a list. When you see a closer, it must match the last opener.
At the end the stack must be empty.
socratic: What should be left at the end?
Compare your output with the goal. What differs?
explain: In one sentence: what is the key idea in “Valid Brackets”?
